title: Thalassophobia
physical_identity: An impossibly large dark ocean under a high concrete ceiling, reached via a furnished carpeted entrance room built sideways into the ceiling.
scale_topology: Apparently infinite ocean room; entrance door ~4.5 m above water; depth zones to beyond 7 km; carpeted floor inferred; a few rock islands.
anomalies: gravity flips in front of the entrance doorway
air lets you hold breath ~30 min
skeletons of flippered humanoids and incomprehensible fish
lighting_sound: Dim natural light at surface, Twilight darker/colder, Midnight completely dark; bubbling from below in the Abyss; sound not otherwise stated.

entities.name: The Thing On Level 7
entities.behavior: Midnight Zone and upper Abyss; light-sensitive

entities.name: Tiny
entities.behavior: Daylight and Twilight Zones; very sensitive hearing

entities.name: Fort Surrender inhabitants
entities.behavior: 4-9 hostile Thing worshippers on an island

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: The Thing On Level 7, Tiny; no other life
hazards: no way back up without rope/ladder
items_communities: bookcase, table, chair, lamp in entrance room

entrances.quote: only known entrance to Level 7 is through a staircase down from Level 6
rumours of a possible entrance through a puddle on the floor of Level 8

exits.method: underwater cave in tall mountain below Midnight Zone
exits.quote: underwater cave on the side of a particularly tall mountain

exits.method: dive into Abyss and go unconscious
exits.quote: going unconscious leads directly to Level 83

exits.method: wooden door in floor of stone platform ~150 m west and ~150 m deep

exits.quote: sailing extremely far to the west of the entrance room

signature_mechanic: Gravity-flipped doorway drops you into a lightless depth-zoned ocean where breath lasts long but two entities rule fixed zones.
verticality: Extreme: surface to over 7 km depth, ceiling 4.5 m above water.
conflicts_notes: Page flagged outdated; Info box has placeholders; footnotes absent. Midnight Zone 'three kilometres below the Twilight Zone' vs Abyss at seven km: arithmetic left as written.

key_quotes.quote: impossibly large ocean that seems to stretch infinitely in all directions
built sideways into the ceiling of Level 7
diving into the Abyss and going unconscious leads directly to Level 83
